steps.text: Exercise the real Postgres/fleet dependencies behind pnpm test:integration against the dedicated nonprod namespace — both dependencies are healthy.
Point Postgres and fleet at unreachable endpoints — the underlying probes fail closed; the pnpm test:integration zero-false-pass result is recorded as supporting evidence.
Reset the dedicated nonprod namespace twice and observe the same deterministic seed fingerprint, table count, and fixture IDs.
steps.literal_cmd: DATABASE_URL=postgres://127.0.0.1:5432/holocron_nonprod HOLO_ALLOW_PROD_SEED=0 bun services/platform/src/cli/holo.ts db seed --reset --json && DATABASE_URL=postgres://127.0.0.1:5432/holocron_nonprod HOLO_ALLOW_PROD_SEED=0 bun services/platform/src/cli/holo.ts db seed --reset --json

steps.text: Verify the PR path contract: tests/ triggers the fast lane on push/PR, while integration is pre-merge and real-service only.
steps.literal_cmd: python3 -c "from pathlib import Path; fast=Path('.github/workflows/ci-fast.yml').read_text(); integ=Path('.github/workflows/ci-integration.yml').read_text(); assert 'push:' in fast and 'pull_request:' in fast and 'pnpm test:unit' in fast; assert 'pull_request:' in integ and 'tests/**' in integ and 'pnpm test:integration' in integ; assert 'runs-on: [self-hosted, holocron, integration]' in integ; print('PR_PATH_CONTRACT=PASS')"
